raw_text: Indian Chronicles Reloaded: How a Pakistan-linked network continued to target the EU and UN. EU DisinfoLab has uncovered the continuation of the 'Indian Chronicles' network — a Pakistan-linked influence operation targeting India's reputation at international forums. The network operates 750+ fake media outlets across 119 countries, impersonates defunct media brands, and uses fake NGOs to lobby at the UN Human Rights Council against India. Key findings: Domain registrations traced to Islamabad-based operators. Content amplified by accounts with Pakistani military connections. Fake European think tanks cited Pakistan government talking points verbatim. The operation has been active since 2005 but has evolved to use new domains and social media amplification strategies.
